topic: Ask about prices at the supermarket: "How much is this?" vs "How much are these?"

script.title: How much is it? – supermarket English

lines.text: Wait, do I say "how much is these"?
One thing, how much is this. Two or more, how much are these.
Excuse me, how much are these apples?
Kit's tip: this is, these are.

script.caption: "How much is this?" vs "How much are these?" #englishtips #supermarket
